host_action_receipt.policy_separation: Receipt status reports host outcome only and never means kernel PASS/BLOCK or Blu authorization.

artifact_receipt.verification_rule: created requires provider evidence; verified requires a bounded read/stat/hash/provider-object check suitable for the surface. A model-emitted filename is not evidence.

delivery_receipt.rule: Do not promote host acceptance/rendering to human_read unless the provider supplies explicit read evidence.

side_effect_rule: An external side effect is not completed merely because it was requested, attempted, approved, or generated. Completion requires an appropriate host/provider receipt; when no receipt exists the adapter reports the evidentiary limitation.
